title: Week 42: XR in Estonia
content:
Week 42: XR in Estonia



I went to the XR Estonia meetup hold by EEVR. It is a two days session. Because there was a class in Friday. I have to skip some talks. I only listened to the Game part and Digital Twin part.



My deepest impression is Jeremy Dalton from PWC. He digged a lot of history of XR. Dome training in WW2.The accident that created 3D movie.





Then Ana Ribeiro told stories about her way from student to VR game developer. And made a studio on pixel ripped.



VSight using AR to help workers remotely. And another company hansab is making a solution like the game overcooked but in industry.



During the second days' session, I tried xReal ans vision pro. I also tried 7 sense to help blind people to see the world.
